title: Sum of First n Terms of an AP — Arithmetic Progressions
hook: Let's explore Sum of First n Terms of an AP from the chapter on Arithmetic Progressions. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Sum of First n Terms of an AP Sₙ = n/2 × [2a + (n−1)d] or equivalently Sₙ = n/2 × (a + l). Gauss's trick: pair first+last, second+second-last, etc. Key Ideas to Master:
💡 Sₙ = n/2 × [2a + (n−1)d] — when last term is unknown
💡 Sₙ = n/2 × (a + l) — when last term l is known
💡 aₙ = Sₙ − Sₙ₋₁ — to find nth term from sum formula
💡 Gauss's insight: S = n/2 × (first + last)
